design_decision.name: UnifiedJudgementCore
design_decision.kind: proposed sealed, citation-indexed inductive judgement over a tagged syntax family
design_decision.not_a_bridge: The core owns the carrier tag, formula indices, citations, and rule constructors. Existing calculi enter only through separately proved conservative injections; there is no coercion between their raw formula types.

proposed_signatures_not_lean.syntax_family: SyntaxFamily : {objectSort : Type} -> Signature objectSort -> RealContext -> BoundContext -> Nat -> Type
constructors: elementary : Elementary Γ -> SyntaxFamily elementarySignature Γ [] 0
ordered : OrderedFormula Γ order -> SyntaxFamily orderedSignature Γ [] order
description : DescriptionSyntax.Formula signature Γ Δ order -> SyntaxFamily signature Γ Δ order
proposed_signatures_not_lean.judgement: CitedJudgement : SyntaxFamily signature Γ Δ order -> Prop
proposed_signatures_not_lean.closed_constructor_discipline: Every constructor is named by one printed PM citation and carries only its printed formula parameters, structural context witness, and already-derived premises. There is no constructor named Primitive, Assumption, Oracle, SemanticValid, Classical, or arbitrary Rule.
detachment_distinct: star_1_1 : CitedJudgement (elementary p) -> CitedJudgement (elementary (p ⊃ₚ q)) -> CitedJudgement (elementary q)
star_1_11 : Γ ≠ [] -> CitedJudgement (elementary φ) -> CitedJudgement (elementary (φ ⊃ₚ ψ)) -> CitedJudgement (elementary ψ)

first_order_rule_schemas.proposed_shape: CitedJudgement (description (always universal body)) -> CitedJudgement (description (instantiateFresh body y))
first_order_rule_schemas.binding_invariant: y must be represented by a source-audited typed real/apparent variable operation, never by an untyped or capture-unsafe substitution.

first_order_rule_schemas.printed_schema: If φy is true whatever possible argument y may be, then (x).φx is true.
first_order_rule_schemas.proposed_shape: CitedJudgement (description (uniformAtFreshVariable body y)) -> CitedJudgement (description (always universal body))
first_order_rule_schemas.binding_invariant: The exact PM side condition for ‘whatever possible argument’ must be collated before any Lean constructor is written.

first_order_rule_schemas.proposed_shape: a closed constructor over the exact object implication/existential Formula nodes, with the same sort, real context, apparent context and assigned order on both matrices
first_order_rule_schemas.binding_invariant: No existential monotonicity is admitted as a polymorphic host-language theorem.

first_order_rule_schemas.proposed_shape: a closed constructor over the exact existential-product Formula nodes
first_order_rule_schemas.binding_invariant: The product and both existentials remain object syntax; the rule does not project a Lean conjunction.

invariants: Descriptions are Formula.descriptionScope only; no DescriptionTerm or HOAS function is introduced.
Formula.substitute/liftSubstitution/weaken remain the only capture-sensitive syntax operations; judgement rules must state their compatibility rather than reimplement substitution.
An injection preserves formula shape, Γ, Δ and order exactly, or states the audited index translation explicitly; it may not erase a description scope.
An injection preserves and reflects derivability for its source calculus; preservation alone is insufficient for the conservativity claim.
PM1:1.1 and PM1:1.11 remain separate constructors. A convenience detachment lemma may pattern-match on context only after both have been installed.
OrderedFormula cannot acquire all-order or cross-order detachment through the unified core; its existing assigned-order limitation is preserved.
No existing theorem is silently retagged: every existing-calculus injection needs a formula embedding and an induction proof over the source derivation.

must_prove: derivation preservation by induction on PM.Derivation
star_1_1 and star_1_11 map to distinct core constructors

must_prove: formula embedding preserves Γ and assigned order
preservation for elementary, star_9_1, star_9_11, star_9_12, star_9_12_elementary_to_first and star_9_13
no new cross-order detachment becomes derivable on the image
required_conservativity_certificates.current_state: blocked: no relation between OrderedFormula and the proposed family is currently certified

must_prove: identity-on-tree embedding preserves signature, Γ, Δ, order and descriptionScope
commutes with substitute, liftSubstitution and weaken
reductional 14.01-14.04 are preserved as syntax equalities
only subsequently source-authorized cited judgement constructors can inhabit its image

vertical_acceptance_test.name: PM1:10.1-to-PM1:14.18-and-14.21
acceptance_conditions: Every link is a CitedJudgement constructor/theorem with precisely the cited PM locus.
The PM1:10.1 instantiation uses only an audited capture-safe operation and preserves the candidate's sort/context.
The Fact link is a conservatively injected PM1:3.45 rule, not a generic frame axiom.
PM1:14.1 and PM1:14.11 are asserted object-equivalences, not Lean rfl substituted for a judgement.
The completed derivations contain no constructor outside the printed chains plus their recursively cited, certified dependencies.
vertical_acceptance_test.current_result: not runnable: all three conservativity certificates and the exact first-order carrier/rule signatures are incomplete

gated_work_order.action: collate exact PM1:1.1/1.11 and first-order judgement carrier/rule signatures
specify a tagged syntax family with no hidden index erasure
prove the three formula injection and derivation conservativity certificates
install only PM1:10.1 and PM1:10.11, then validate their binding invariants
install cited dependencies through PM1:10.5/10.28/10.35 and asserted PM1:14.1/14.11
gated_work_order.gate: step 4 plus each printed transitive dependency

gated_work_order.action: run the vertical acceptance proof for PM1:14.18 and PM1:14.21

verdict: NO-IMPLEMENTATION-YET: the architecture can be specified as a closed citation-indexed core, but no actual unified carrier or injection is conservative until its certificates are proved.
